;Health and environment 
*[[COVID-19 pandemic]]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Europe]]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in the United Kingdom]]
****[[COVID-19 pandemic in England]], [[First COVID-19 tier regulations in England|COVID-19 tier regulations in England]]
*****It is announced that [[South Yorkshire]] will move into tier three restrictions at 00:01 a.m. [[British Summer Time|BST]] on October 24, after a deal was reached between local leaders and the government to provide £41 million in extra support. The restrictions will cover around 1.4 million people in [[Barnsley]], [[Doncaster]], [[Rotherham]], [[Sheffield]], and the surrounding areas. [https://www.bbc.com/news/uk-54627017 (BBC News)] [https://www.itv.com/news/2020-10-21/sheffield-expected-to-be-moved-to-tier-3-covid-restrictions-after-talks-with-south-yorkshire-leaders (ITV)]
****The number of confirmed cases in the [[United Kingdom]] surges to a new record high of 26,688, bringing the total number of confirmed cases to 789,229. [https://news.sky.com/story/coronavirus-uk-covid-cases-hit-highest-ever-daily-figure-of-26-688-12110256 (Sky News)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Italy]]
****[[Lombardy]] reports a new record high of new infections, with 4,120 new cases reported in the last 24 hours and positivity rates surging to 11%. [https://www.ilgiorno.it/coronavirus-bollettino-oggi-21-ottobre-lombardia-1.5632878 (''Il Giorno'')]
****[[Italy]] registers 15,199 new infections in the past 24 hours, according to the [[Ministry of Health (Italy)|health ministry]], the highest daily tally since the start of the outbreak in the country. While deaths increase by 127, this is the first time virus-related deaths have surged above 100 since May. [https://www.rte.ie/news/coronavirus/2020/1021/1172872-coronavirus-global/ (RTÉ)]
****It is announced that [[Lazio]] will introduce a [[curfew]] between midnight and 5:00 a.m. local time starting October 23, becoming the third Italian region to impose a curfew, after Lombardy and [[Campania]]. [https://www.ilmessaggero.it/roma/news/coprifuoco_lazio_ultime_notizie_oggi_21_ottobre_2020_mezzanotte_roma_covid-5537678.html (''Il Messaggero'')]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in the Czech Republic]]
****[[Czech Republic]] reports a new record high of new infections in a single day, with 11,984 new cases reported in the last 24 hours, taking the nationwide total to 193,246. [https://timesofindia.indiatimes.com/world/europe/cases-in-czech-republic-soar-to-12k-amid-new-measures/articleshow/78785014.cms (''The Times Of India'')]
****In response to the surge of new cases, the [[Government of Czech Republic|Czech government]] announces that it will close non-essential shops and limit the people's movement to essential reasons only in new [[COVID-19 pandemic lockdowns|lockdown]] measures effective between tomorrow at 6:00 a.m. and November 3 at 11:59 p.m. local time. [https://www.politico.eu/article/czech-government-to-impose-lockdown-measures/ (''Politico'')]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Spain]]
****[[Spain]] exceeds one million cases of COVID-19, becoming the first country in the [[European Union|EU]] to do so. [https://news.sky.com/story/coronavirus-spain-becomes-first-country-in-western-europe-to-record-one-million-cases-12110460 (Sky News)]
****[[La Rioja]] becomes the second region to go into perimetral lockdown. [https://www.lavanguardia.com/vida/20201021/484211667868/la-rioja-confinamiento-perimetral-cierre-establecimientos.html (''La Vanguardia'')]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Germany]]
****[[Federal Ministry of Health (Germany)|Federal Health Minister]] [[Jens Spahn]] tests positive for COVID-19. [https://www.dw.com/en/german-health-minister-jens-spahn-tests-positive-for-coronavirus/a-55350601 (DW)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Greece]]
****[[Greece]] reports 865 new cases in the past 24 hours, a new record high, raising the number of confirmed cases to 27,334, according to data from the [[National Public Health Organization (Greece)|National Public Health Organization]] [https://www.ekathimerini.com/258329/article/ekathimerini/news/new-infections-smash-new-record-reaching-865 (''Ekathimerini'')]
****[[Ministry of Citizen Protection (Greece)|Greek Civil Protection]] Deputy Minister [[Nikos Hardalias]] announces the designation of [[Kastoria]] into Level Four (red zone) and imposes a local lockdown in the region starting October 23 in an attempt to curb the spread of COVID-19 in the region. [https://news.gtp.gr/2020/10/21/greece-announces-covid-19-red-alert-for-kastoria/ (Greek Travel Pages)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Croatia]]
****[[Croatia]] registers 1,424 new infections in the last 24 hours, a new record high since the beginning of the [[pandemic]]. [https://www.croatiaweek.com/croatia-reports-record-high-of-1424-new-coronavirus-infections/ (''Croatia Week'')]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Poland]]
****[[Poland]] surpasses 200,000 [[COVID-19]] cases after a record 10,040 new cases were reported by the [[Ministry of Health (Poland)|Health Ministry]] in the last 24 hours. [https://www.swissinfo.ch/eng/poland-s-total-coronavirus-cases-top-200-000/46110530 (Swiss Info)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Russia]]
****[[Russia]] reports a record 317 new fatalities, taking the nationwide total to 24,952, as the country resists reintroducing strict lockdown measures. [https://www.themoscowtimes.com/2020/10/21/russia-breaks-record-for-daily-coronavirus-deaths-a71810 (''The Moscow Times'')]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Slovakia]]
****[[Slovakia]] reports 2,202 new cases in the last 24 hours, a new record in a single day since the start of the pandemic, according to data from the Health Ministry. [https://www.reuters.com/article/health-coronavirus-slovakia/slovakia-reports-2202-new-cases-of-coronavirus-highest-daily-tally-idUSL8N2HC2GX (Reuters)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Slovenia]]
****[[Slovenia]] reports 1,503 new cases in the past 24 hours, its highest number yet, taking the nationwide total to 15,982. In addition, a record eight people have died in the last 24 hours. [https://english.sta.si/2821945/record-1503-coronavirus-cases-in-slovenia-on-tuesday-eight-people-die (STA)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Ukraine]]
****[[Ukraine]] registers a record 6,719 new infections in the past 24 hours, bringing the total number of confirmed COVID-19 cases to 309,107, according to the interactive map of the [[National Security and Defense Council of Ukraine|NSDC]]. [https://www.kyivpost.com/ukraine-politics/ukrinform-ukraine-reports-6719-new-coronavirus-cases.html?cn-reloaded=1 (''Kyiv Post'')]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Asia]]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Iran]]
****[[Iran]] announces a record-high single-day spike in new cases since the first case was reported in [[Qom]] in February, with 5,616 new infections reported in the last 24 hours, according to a statement from Health Ministry spokeswoman Sima-Sadat Lari. [https://www.aa.com.tr/en/latest-on-coronavirus-outbreak/iran-records-highest-single-day-virus-infections/2014070 (Anadolu Agency)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Jordan]]
****[[Jordan]] reports 2,648 new cases, its highest daily number since the start of the pandemic as the country faces a major outbreak, with a tripling of deaths in just the last two weeks. The record numbers increase its total of cases to 43,620. [https://www.reuters.com/article/uk-health-coronavirus-jordan-surge/jordan-announces-record-daily-new-covid-19-cases-idUKKBN276379 (Reuters)]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in the United States]]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Ohio]]
****The [[Ohio Department of Health]] registers 2,366 cases in the last 24 hours. This is the highest single-day increase in cases for [[Ohio]] during the pandemic, and this brings the statewide total to 188,005. [https://fox8.com/news/coronavirus/2366-coronavirus-cases-reported-in-last-24-hours-sets-new-record-in-ohio/ (WJW-TV)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Wisconsin]]
****[[Wisconsin]] reports a record 48 new deaths, bringing the state's death toll to 1,681 and the death rate up from 0.91% to 0.92%. [https://www.wbay.com/2020/10/21/wisconsin-adds-4205-coronavirus-cases-record-48-covid-19-deaths-death-rate-goes-back-up/ (WBAY-TV)]

;Law and crime
*[[Trial of Catalonia independence leaders#Audiencia Nacional|Trial of Catalonia independence leaders]]
**The former leadership of the [[Mossos d'Esquadra]], the [[Catalonia|Catalan]] regional police, whose defendants are Major [[Josep Lluís Trapero]], Pere Soler, [[Cèsar Puig]], and Lieutenant [[Teresa Laplana]], are acquitted by the [[Audiencia Nacional|National Audience]] of the crimes of [[sedition]] and disobedience for their role during the [[2017 Catalan independence referendum]]. [https://www.lavanguardia.com/politica/20201020/484205374550/trapero-absuelto-audiencia-nacional.html (''La Vanguardia'')]
